properties.name: A declared dependency on another design can be watched without importing it
properties.rationale:
Anthony's word 2026-08-26, manifest-driven form chosen over a stateless caller-supplies-paths form: the child list should live in the committed manifest rather than in a per-machine config or the agent's head, which is the property that made this route worth taking at all.

WHY THIS RATHER THAN A HUB RELATION. `fact:the-hub-wants-what-an-accepted-requirement-already-half-built` carries the measurement. Two of the hub case's four wants are the unbuilt half of an ACCEPTED requirement, not new vocabulary — so they arrive with no tracker objection to answer and no third composition mode to define.

⚠️ THE RULE THIS BENDS, NAMED BEFORE IT IS BENT. reflow2-core does no file I/O, deliberately and repeatedly, and `describe_designs` makes the CALLER find candidate paths because reflow2 does no file navigation. Reading an upstream export means reading a file this design was pointed at BY ITS OWN COMMITTED MANIFEST, which is a weaker claim than navigating — but it is not nothing, and it is why the read belongs at the MCP layer beside `sync_debt`, never in the core. That placement is the same call `sync_debt` already made and for the same stated reason.

⚠️ IT MUST NOT SILENCE ITSELF. The recorded hash is what the declarer LAST LOOKED AT, and re-reading must never quietly update it — a check that refreshed its own baseline would report `moved` exactly once and then go permanently quiet. Re-declaring is the acknowledgement, which is `dec:ask-not-repair` applied here: name the remedy, never take it.

⚠️ WHAT IT DOES NOT DELIVER. A dependency declaration says I DEPEND ON that; a hub says I AM ANSWERABLE FOR that. Where a hub merely owns a child, expressing that as a dependency would be the modelling fiction the hxm_program report objected to. Hub wants #1 (cross-design realization) and #3 (verification roll-up) are untouched, and so is the downward-inheritance direction.
properties.subject: system
properties.summary: Builds the second check `req:design-dependencies-declared` names and only half-delivered: declared-versus-UPSTREAM, "has what I depend on moved since". A declaration that names another reflow2 design gains an optional path to that design's committed export; reflow2 reads the file's content hash at declaration time and reports on later reads whether the upstream has moved, without importing it. Chosen over the existing route because the only two ways a path enters the watch record today are export_graph and import_graph, and importing a child ABSORBS it under the host's name.
